title.narrative: Decrease of TB Burden in Kazakhstan through Strengthening of Multi-Drug Resistant TB Management - Kazakhstan (01-Jan-2012-31-Dec-2015)

description.narrative: Kazakhstan’s Round 8 TB grant serves as an extension of the country’s Round 6 grant. With additional Global Fund support, the Ministry of Health is able to expand quality multidrug-resistant TB control activities that are not covered by the government budget, the Round 6 Global Fund grant, or donor agencies.
